definitions.cold: This checkout's applications/playground/.tmp removed and BUN_RUNTIME_TRANSPILER_CACHE_PATH set to a new empty run-owned directory; the exporter clears build/ itself; no OS cache flush.
definitions.warm: Immediately after the cold sample, a new process with the same transpiler cache directory and the same disk inputs.
definitions.childMaxResidentBytes: Bun.Subprocess.resourceUsage().maxRSS, bytes on every platform: one process's own high-water mark.
definitions.treePeakResidentBytes: Largest sum of ps rss (KiB x 1024) across the child and its descendants, sampled every 100 ms by one observer for baseline and candidate.
definitions.spawnToReadyMilliseconds: Spawn of bun src/playground-server.ts to the first GET /ready answering 200 "ready", polled every 100 ms.
definitions.jsHeap: Chromium JS heap through CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage; never summed with RSS.
definitions.hostLoad: uptime load averages and os.availableParallelism() captured before and after every sample.
definitions.loadGate: Record-only by default: every sample records the load averages, logical processors, and memory pressure without waiting. --maximum-load-factor opts into holding each sample while the 1-minute load exceeds that factor times the logical processors.
definitions.memoryPressure: The process-tree observer reads kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level (1 normal, 2 warning, 4 critical) on every 100 ms tick. A sample whose maximum is above normal, or which has no reading, is flagged; a flagged run exits nonzero, and compare refuses a primary memory observation from a flagged sample.
